review_description: Excellent service from obtaining a quote right through to installation and after installation customer service
Due to the withdrawal of the NSW Govt 'rebate' decisions were delayed but that's no reflection on CES. The install itself was great & the commissioning no problem.

To be really honest this was the only provider in town that bothered to quote in a timely manner. Their sales team were knowledgeable and actually listened to our goals and based their recommendation on them. The quote came back quickly and their documentation was clear and understandable. Electronic signatures made acceptance easy. Install was scheduled promptly and their install team turned up on time. Workmanship was very good and we got everything in the places we asked for. The install even leaves room for additional batteries to be easily added in the future. Very happy.

From the time Bree from Clean Energy Solutions came through the door to the installation process it was a very positive experience.  Bree had the ability to help us understand the monolith that is solar to the lay person and gave balanced answers to our questions; not only answers that would favour her company. Installation day came and no problems were encountered.  I would not hesitate to recomnmend this company.

We had a couple of very close quotes, in dollar terms, and both presentations were informative, extremely friendly and punctual. We chose Bree's quote from Clean Energy Solutions not only on price but we preferred the choice of panels and inverter they recommended.We were quoted a prompt installation date which they adhered to and apart from a last minute change of panel due to availablity which was a bit frustrating the whole installation process went very smoothly with a friendly team and good communication from Daniel.I would certainly recommend them to anyone looking for an installation in the area.
Andrew was knowledgeable and helpful, his installation team were excellent tradesmen, polite and offered great advice. Five star experience, highly recommend this company
Customer service outstanding - everything explained and suggestions made. Installers professional, polite and tidy.
From the moment we reached out the service was second to none.  Highly recommend.

We received two quotes after talking about the size of the system we wanted. Not much difference in cost between the two but using the same brand inverter and panels. The process was very good. Representatives from both companies were polite, knowledgeable and there was no pressure to sign up.Installation was done when said it would be. Installers were quick, friendly, knowledgeable and tidy. No mess left.Plenty of information given about shutting down the system and bringing it up again.The app was explained to us and the installation included organizing for the power meter to be changed to a smart meter which took a couple of weeks.Since then, we have received from Solar Quotes, a list of power providers in our area and the various prices for peak, off peak and solar. That is very helpful.

A professional and seamless process from start to finish. We appreciated Bree's prompt site visit after our initial enquiry, where lots of solar information was shared with us and we were able to ask lots of questions. Jacob's visit with his team just 3 weeks later was very smooth, thanks to his knowledge, experience and expertise. As well as the installation of a new solar battery and inverter, we also had 9 obsolete solar panels removed and 9 new ones installed to supplement the existing 20 solar panels. The work was carried out in a timely, cost efficient and skilful manner with excellent customer service demonstrated by all personnel. Clean Energy Solutions also organised all the paperwork, the NSW Government rebate, the grid connection and showed us how to install the iSolarCloud app on our phones. We are delighted that we supported a local company who have a showroom very close to where we live so we can pop in at any time with questions etc. Clean Energy Solutions also carry out ongoing monitoring of the system to ensure everything is working like it should! I recommend Clean Energy Solutions for all solar energy installations.

The planned installation included an inverter that was borderline sufficient. I had thought that the consequence of its capacity being breached would be that the system works simply draw more from the grid rather than from the battery. The consequence on testing the system with 10kW inverter was that, when too much power was being drawn (eg. oven, AC and one other appliance), power was lost to the whole house. Clearly that wasn't acceptable, so Andrew from Clean Energy Solutions promptly attached to have the 10kW inverter replaced with the 15kW model. Now the system works as hoped. I only wish I'd requested/applied for an extra stackable unit or two of kWh to take advantage of the current incentive. Ah, well even with three incentive the cost for additional kWh is still not cheap. I expect I'll be looking to beef up the battery down the track. Meanwhile, I'm very happy with the quoting, subsequent installation and post installation service provided by Clean Energy Solutions Albury.
Customer service was excellent, installation was on time and they did a fantastic job.Would definitely recommend.
The quoting process was great straight forward professional and a Fair Price Quoted.
Prompt, efficient, no nonsense. Didnt have to worry about anything.

Our sales person was very helpful and informative. Brianna took time to answer our questions and to discuss different options.Brianna assisted us with filling out the applications for the government rebates and interest free loans.Our system was completed in one day and the workers were helpful, polite and cleaned up the site.Communication was excellent. Price was very competitive.Once the decision was made the process was very quick.

A great local team!  So happy with Bree, Daniel and the boys…,excellent advice, communication, inspection and installation top job….  always up to date with the comms and open for any questionsOn time, very tidy and respectful and friendly customer service highly rated
On time worked hard in extreme heat helped with paper work and setup recommend to everyone thinking about solar

I wanted to write a review for Clean Energy Solutions (Greenhouse Solar and Electrical) located in Albury, after really such a great experience and being super happy with the end result; knowing how daunting it is for anyone to choose an installer with all the hype and risks these days.As anyone would recommend, I went through Solar Quotes and had several installers contact me.One installer didn’t even want to visit my property which is 2-phase and included 3 buildings (main residence, cottage and machinery shed). This was a red flag and an instant fail for me.The second installer came out to visit and quoted / scoped the system which was fine, but failed to mention any finer details about needing to dig a trench to run solar DC lines from the main residence back to the shed where the main meter was. Fail.Clean Energy Solutions (Greenhouse Solar and Electrical) came out to visit (twice) and spent a good deal of time to fully scope their works with every detail and the only company to tell me about needing to locate the Inverters and Battery next to the main meter, and requiring a trench to run the DC cables between the main residence and the shed (where the main meter is).Their sales person, Andrew, I found had a depth of technical knowledge that gave me every confidence and also the only company that mentioned CBAs Green Loan to help pay for the installation.Clean Energy Solutions (Greenhouse Solar and Electrical) sent out their crews to fit the ~20kw of solar panels, 2x 10kw Inverters and ~12kwh of battery storage neatly in the shed on the 28th and 29th December! Also removing the smaller solar installation on the cottage that was 20 years old, and helping to rewire the circuit board to best configure the new solar system across the two phases.Despite the challenge of fitting such a large system between Christmas and New Year with a 2 Phase farm / residence, these guys were amazing, friendly and professional. The installation was very neat and clean. They even pitched in to help backfill the trench which was certainly not part of their scope.The crew were very helpful and helped me with all my questions during the installation.I would not hesitate at all to highly recommend Clean Energy Solutions (Greenhouse Solar and Electrical) for your solar project.
